label: kaorispring1
title_zh: 白色的海洋（为什么不在这里？）

lines.en: label kaorispring1:
scene nightsky
I decide to spend the night wandering around in hopes of maybe bumping into Yumi or something since that’s how things always used to work before the world went to shit.
lines.zh: 我决定今晚四处逛逛，说不定能碰上 Yumi 什么的，毕竟世界变糟之前，事情一直都是这么运作的。

lines.en: Or I guess closer to shit than it already was since I have ultimately uncovered the fact that my life has always been pretty fucking terrible.
lines.zh: 或者说，是变得更糟一点，因为我最终发现了这个事实：我的人生一直都他妈糟糕透顶。

lines.en: And that really makes me question why I stopped suppressing things in the first place when {i}not{/i} doing that really just makes me feel worse.
lines.zh: 这真的让我开始怀疑，当初为什么不再压抑下去了 —— {i}不压抑{/i}反而让我更难受。

lines.en: I get that I’m probably supposed to use this as fuel to recover and “become a better person” or something but, let’s face it, that’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: 我知道我应该把这当成动力去康复、去「变成一个更好的人」什么的，但老实说，那不可能发生。

lines.en: Because not only do I lack the strength to do so — I possess a critical weakness in being so easily infatuated by anyone who shows me affection that I have no choice but to fall for them.
lines.zh: 因为我不光没有那份力气 —— 我还有一个致命弱点：任何对我示好的人，我都会轻易地迷上，别无选择地爱上对方。

lines.en: And there comes a point in falling where it’s just fucking annoying.
lines.zh: 而坠入爱河到了某个地步，就只剩下他妈的烦人。

lines.en: Just let me hit the ground already and save myself from this seemingly unending story that I can only imagine exhausts {i}you{/i} just as much as it does me.
lines.zh: 干脆让我摔到地上得了，好让我从这个看似没完没了的故事里解脱出来 —— 我想这故事让{i}你{/i}厌烦的程度，大概不亚于让我厌烦。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons1
I guess that’ll have to wait, though — as I have now bumped not into Yumi, but the one Yumi-adjacent being that I have put my penis inside of. Weirdly enough.
lines.zh: 不过看来还得再等等 —— 因为我现在撞上的不是 Yumi，而是那个与 Yumi 有关联、而我曾经把阴茎放进过的存在。说来也怪。

lines.en: : Thank you, human customer person! We apologize that you will need to go further away to find the yellow spheres of your sourest desires!
lines.zh: : 谢谢您，人类顾客先生！非常抱歉，您需要走得更远一些，才能找到您那酸到极致的渴望 —— 那些黄色球体！

lines.en: : Kaori? Nao? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : Kaori？Nao？你们在这儿干什么？

lines.en: scene kaorilemons2
: Ah! Sexfriend!
lines.zh: : 啊！性朋友！

lines.en: : Please don’t call me that in public.
lines.zh: : 在公共场合别这么叫我。

lines.en: : Then, regular Friend! The Nao-chan and I have decided to open a lemon-assistance stand!
lines.zh: : 那就叫普通朋友！我和 Nao 酱决定开一个柠檬援助摊！

lines.en: : A lemon...assistance stand?
lines.zh: : 柠檬……援助摊？

lines.en: : Correct! To aid humans in the retrieval of lemons!
lines.zh: : 没错！帮助人类获取柠檬！

lines.en: : Oh, I think I see what happened here. But that’s not even the right spelling of-
lines.zh: : 哦，我大概明白是怎么回事了。可这连拼写都不对——

lines.en: : Three blocks west! Two blocks straight! Go, go, go! Let your sourest dreams run wild!
lines.zh: : 往西三个街区！再直走两个！冲啊冲啊冲啊！让你最酸的梦想尽情狂奔！

lines.en: scene kaorilemons3
: Nothing good ever comes from letting my dreams run wild, so I’ll just hang out here for a little bit and and try to figure out why this is your latest business venture.
lines.zh: : 让我的梦想狂奔从来没带来过什么好事，所以我就在这儿待一会儿，顺便搞明白这怎么会成了你的最新创业项目。

lines.en: : There are no works to work on this night! Let alone works that would work the Nao-chan! So I am teaching her the ins and outs of produce distribution!
lines.zh: : 今晚没有可以上的班！更别提能让 Nao 酱上的班了！所以我在教她农产品分销的方方面面！

lines.en: scene kaorilemons4
: Unfortunately, there is an evil human organization known only as the “Produce Delivery Administration” that appears to have a Sorry! on the distribution of the lemonfruit.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是，有一个只被称为「农产品配送管理局」的邪恶人类组织，似乎对柠檬果的分销下了「抱歉！」。

lines.en: : Wrong board game, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 那是另一款桌游，Kaori。

lines.en: : I am very Monopoly for the mistake, Friend. I am doing my best.
lines.zh: : 我为这个错误感到非常「大富翁」，朋友。我已经尽力了。

lines.en: : Are you {i}really,{/i} though?
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}尽力了吗？

lines.en: scene kaorilemons5
: Reverse-no! That is precisely why we have obtained the other fruits that we are legally authorized to sell!
lines.zh: : 反过来说才不对！正因如此，我们才弄来了别的、我们合法可以卖的水果！

lines.en: : Unfortunately, however, most of the customers who have come here have only been interested in lemons. With the exception of a sole duck who inquired about the purchasing of grapes.
lines.zh: : 可惜的是，来这儿的顾客大多只对柠檬感兴趣。除了一只鸭子，问过要不要买葡萄。

lines.en: : Staying true to our name, though, we offer free guidance to the nearest lemonfruit vendor in exchange for only 100 yen!
lines.zh: : 不过我们名副其实，会免费提供指引，告诉你最近的柠檬果摊在哪儿，只收 100 日元！

lines.en: : That...is not “free” guidance, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 那……就不叫「免费」指引了，Kaori。

lines.en: : All guidance is free in America, Friendburger.
lines.zh: : 在美国，所有指引都是免费的，朋友堡。

lines.en: : This is Japan.
lines.zh: : 这里是日本。

lines.en: : Land of the brave. Home of the sour.
lines.zh: : 勇者之地。酸味之乡。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons6
: Kaori-
lines.zh: : Kaori——

lines.en: : Name a fruit and we will help you find it! Or don’t! But please do! Aunt Yuki needs the money!
lines.zh: : 说出一种水果，我们就帮你找到它！或者别找！但请一定要说！Yuki 阿姨需要钱！

lines.en: : Yuki? You mean you’re-
lines.zh: : Yuki？你是说你——

lines.en: scene kaorilemons7
: Helping her become healed. She is currently in the process of dying, and it is my understanding that we can clear the black clouds above her with legal tendies.
lines.zh: : 帮她好起来。她目前正在走向死亡，而据我所知，我们可以用法定鸡块驱散她头顶的乌云。

lines.en: : Legal tender. Just say money.
lines.zh: : 是法定货币。直接说钱就行。

lines.en: : Legal boneless buffalo wings. I understand perfectly.
lines.zh: : 法定无骨水牛城鸡翅。我完全明白了。

lines.en: if tsubasaspring4miss == True:
scene kaorilemons7fuck1
scene kaorilemons7fuck2
: Ugh! This shit is getting impossible to keep up with and I am GOSH DARN tired of it!!!
lines.zh: : 呜！这玩意儿越来越跟不上，我真是烦死它了！！！

lines.en: This is Connor. He's in charge of maintaining continuity in the world and only shows up when there are certain mistakes that would take way too long to fix otherwise.
lines.zh: 这位是 Connor。他负责维护这个世界的连续性，只在某些要不然修起来太费劲的错误出现时才会露面。

lines.en: He will now explain to you why he is here and why you have to look at him.
lines.zh: 他现在要向你解释他为什么在这里，以及你为什么非得看着他。

lines.en: : Okay. So, for some reason, you've decided to play the game like a fucking LOSER and avoid boning certain cartoons because their cartoon age is lower than that of the other cartoons.
lines.zh: : 好吧。出于某种原因，你决定像个他妈的窝囊废一样玩这个游戏，还偏偏不睡某些卡通人物，就因为她们的卡通年龄比其他卡通人物小。

lines.en: connor "So BECAUSE you're down to clown with the high school cartoons and muddy up the plot of the game by avoiding the others and playing a route the creator despises due to the fundamental disconnect it sews between the actions of the protagonist
lines.zh: connor "所以就因为你愿意跟高中卡通人物胡搞，还躲开其他人、把游戏剧情搅得一团糟，去走一条创作者深恶痛绝的路线 —— 因为这条路线会在主角的行为

lines.en: and the game's overarching themes of abuse, you have encountered a CONTINUITY ERROR."
lines.zh: 与游戏关于虐待的总体主题之间撕开一道根本的裂口 —— 于是你遇到了一个「连续性错误」。

lines.en: : And chances are you'll encounter more in the future since writing branching narratives is hard as FUCK and Selebus straight up forgets you exist sometimes.
lines.zh: : 而且以后你多半还会遇到更多，因为写分支叙事他妈的难，而且 Selebus 有时候干脆就忘了你的存在。

lines.en: : Anyway, if you were playing the game correctly and leading the protagonist down his rightfully wrongful path of debauchery, you'd have learned by now that {i}HE{/i} learned that Yuki is okay. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 总之，如果你玩得对，把主角带上他那条错误得理直气壮的堕落之路，你现在早该知道 —— {i}他{/i}知道了 Yuki 没事。算是吧。

lines.en: : In the proper route, Sensei goes to Tsukioka manor and finds all of this information out before a bunch of chairs show up and some girls take notes on penises and other penis-adjacent content.
lines.zh: : 在正确的路线里，Sensei 会去 Tsukioka 宅邸，在一堆椅子出现、几个女孩开始记录阴茎和其他与阴茎相关的内容之前，把这些信息全部弄清楚。

lines.en: : So go ahead and just pretend he knows that now and save the creator some time. Thanks!
lines.zh: : 所以你就当现在他也知道了，帮创作者省点时间。谢啦！

lines.en: Connor begins to bash his Hammer of Correction against the screen and all is suddenly good and there are no more continuity issues. Go play the wizard route.
lines.zh: Connor 开始用他的「修正之锤」砸屏幕，于是一切突然就好了，再也没有连续性问题了。去玩巫师路线吧。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons8
else:
scene kaorilemons8
: Kaori, this is a...very nice thing you’re doing. And I’m sure Yuki would greatly appreciate it. But I don’t think she needs the money anymore.
lines.zh: : Kaori，你做的这件事……非常好。我相信 Yuki 会很感激的。但我觉得她已经不需要钱了。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons9
: SHE ALREADY DIED?! THAT WAS SO FAST!
lines.zh: : 她已经死了？！这也太快了吧！

lines.en: : No, no. She did not {i}die.{/i} She just found someone with a lot of money who’s willing to take care of her until she gets better.
lines.zh: : 不，不。她没有{i}死{/i}。她只是找到了一个很有钱、愿意照顾她直到她好起来的人。

lines.en: : This is information you should have immediately provided without giving me the opportunity to gasp!
lines.zh: : 这种信息你本该立刻告诉我，别给我喘气的机会！

lines.en: : I’m kind of surprised she didn’t tell you if you were already in the loop about this. I can fill in some of the details, but...maybe {i}without{/i} Nao present?
lines.zh: : 有点意外她没告诉你，毕竟你早就知道这事了。我可以补充一些细节，不过……也许{i}别让{/i} Nao 在场？

lines.en: scene kaorilemons10
: Nao-chan says, “What the frick, man?”
lines.zh: : Nao 酱说：「搞什么啊，老兄？」

lines.en: : She’s just too young to hear about death and stuff and I have a pre-existing disposition toward this because of things that have happened to the small human I raised.
lines.zh: 她还太小，听不了死亡之类的事情，而我本来就对这种事很敏感，因为我养大的那个小小人类身上发生过一些事。

lines.en: : Then, would it not be better for her to learn about these concepts {i}before{/i} she is ultimately forced to experience them and subsequently thrown into traumatic shock?
lines.zh: : 那么，在她最终不得不亲身经历这些、并被随之抛入创伤性休克之前，让她{i}先{/i}了解这些概念不是更好吗？

lines.en: : Nope. That makes too much sense for a horrible parent like me.
lines.zh: : 不。这对我来说太讲道理了 —— 我可是个糟糕的家长。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons11
: I understand. In that case, Nao-chan, please give us a moment and go hand out the sour information notes to those who pass our fruit-shelter.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。那么，Nao 酱，请给我们一点时间，去把「酸味情报传单」发给路过我们水果棚的人吧。

lines.en: : What’d she say that time?
lines.zh: : 她这次说了什么？

lines.en: : Something about your input being somehow less valuable than the items that we are peddling.
lines.zh: : 大意是说，你的意见不知怎么地不如我们贩卖的东西有价值。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons12
: This time, she says “Baaaaaaaaaka.”
lines.zh: : 这次，她说的是「笨——蛋——」。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons13

Nao hurries off and starts handing out what I can only imagine is some sort of flier to anyone who passes by, giving me an opportunity to figure out just how much Kaori knows and...{i}understands.{/i}
lines.zh: Nao 赶紧跑开，开始向来来往往的每个人发某种我看八成是传单的东西，这让我有机会弄清 Kaori 到底知道多少、又……{i}理解{/i}多少。

lines.en: : Does being alone mean that you are going to do the sex to me again?
lines.zh: : 只剩我们两个人，是不是意味着你又要对我做那个事了？

lines.en: I don’t think she understands much.
lines.zh: 我觉得她理解得不多。

lines.en: : This is probably not the time for that. We’re kind of in the middle of something, remember?
lines.zh: : 现在大概不是时候。我们正忙着呢，记得吗？

lines.en: : I’m Monopoly again. I don’t have much sexperience, so I don’t know how this goes.
lines.zh: : 我又「大富翁」了。我没有太多性经验，所以不知道该怎么来。

lines.en: : Kaori, how much do you know about Yuki’s situation? Because it’s clearly enough to start trying to raise money for her, but...do you understand how serious this predicament is?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你对 Yuki 的情况知道多少？显然够多了，多到你开始为她筹钱，可是……你明白这处境有多严重吗？

lines.en: : Very serious if it can make Aunt Yukiburger cry. I had assumed her tear production facility went out of service before I even became the Queen of Spiders.
lines.zh: : 严重到能让 Yuki 堡阿姨哭的话，那就非常严重了。我原以为早在当上蜘蛛女王之前，她的眼泪生产工厂就已经停产了。

lines.en: : Who is this person she has found with seemingly deep pockets? Are they deep enough to fit a horse?
lines.zh: : 她找到的这个看起来很有钱的人是谁？有钱到能塞进一匹马吗？

lines.en: : If you mean {i}buy{/i} a horse, yes. Tsubasa has several horses, I imagine.
lines.zh: : 如果你是说{i}买{/i}得起一匹马，那是的。Tsubasa 有好几匹马吧，我想。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons14
: Tsubasa?!
lines.zh: : Tsubasa？！

lines.en: : Do you...{i}know{/i} her somehow too?
lines.zh: : 你也……{i}认识{/i}她？

lines.en: : No!
lines.zh: : 不认识！

lines.en: : Then...what is this reaction, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那……你这反应到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene kaorilemons15
: Monopoly three. I thought I was supposed to act surprised. I do not typically receive good news.
lines.zh: : 「大富翁」之三。我以为这时候应该表现得惊讶一点。我平时很少收到好消息。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. It’s {i}good{/i} news for sure. But this doesn’t mean she is out of the weeds yet, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是{i}好{/i}消息没错。但这不代表她已经脱离险境了，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons16
: It means we must find a machete to free her from the foliage!
lines.zh: : 意思是说我们必须找一把砍刀，把她从草丛里解救出来！

lines.en: : {i}No.{/i} It means she still has a lot of fighting left to do if she’s going to beat her illness.
lines.zh: : {i}不是{/i}。意思是说，她要战胜病魔，还有很长的仗要打。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons17
: But she {i}will{/i} beat it, yes?
lines.zh: : 但她{i}会{/i}赢的，对吧？

lines.en: : I...haven’t really talked to her about it at length, but she definitely seemed less...fatalistic than when I talked to her last. Which I can only assume is good.
lines.zh: : 我……没跟她细聊过，但她确实比我上次跟她聊的时候，看起来没那么……听天由命了。我想这应该算是好事。

lines.en: : Does the Yumi know yet?
lines.zh: : 那个 Yumi 知道了吗？

lines.en: : That’s...a good question.
lines.zh: : 这……是个好问题。

lines.en: : The Yumi should know. Aunt Yuki was very worried about her.
lines.zh: : 那个 Yumi 应该知道。Yuki 阿姨很担心她。

lines.en: : So much so that she made me her honorary mothermom. But I feel as if I am doing a bad job as I have not been able to find her yet.
lines.zh: : 担心到她封我为荣誉妈妈。但我觉得自己干得很糟，因为我到现在还没能找到她。

lines.en: : Uh...give me a minute, Kaori. I’m going to call her and make sure she’s not being eaten alive by misery anymore.
lines.zh: : 呃……给我一分钟，Kaori。我给她打个电话，确保她没再被痛苦活活吞掉。

lines.en: : Okay, but you may need to do it very loudly as this is a large city and she may not be nearby.
lines.zh: : 好的，不过你可能得喊得非常大声，因为这是个大城市，她可能不在附近。

lines.en: scene nightsky
: I think I’ll be fine, thanks.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没问题的，谢了。

lines.en: I tap on Yumi’s name in my phone, half-excited to break the good news to her and half-{i}worried{/i} that she’s just going to blow me off upon hearing it as I still don’t really know how she’s processing-
lines.zh: 我在手机里点下 Yumi 的名字，一半是为了能把这个好消息告诉她而兴奋，一半是{i}担心{/i}她听完就会把我打发走，毕竟我还是不太清楚她在怎么处理——

lines.en: : {i}Hello?{/i}
Monopo- sorry. Holding that thought.
lines.zh: 「大富」——抱歉。先打住。

lines.en: : Hey. Are you alone right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你现在一个人吗？

lines.en: : {i}Hah...I kissed you on the cheek one time and now you’re calling me for phone sex? Fuck off, dude.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈……我就亲过你脸颊一次，你现在就打电话来搞电话性爱？滚一边去，老兄。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m calling you about your mom, actually. And before {i}you{/i} start freaking out thinking I’m delivering bad news, I’m-
lines.zh: : 其实我是为了你妈的事打来的。在{i}你{/i}开始慌、以为我要报噩耗之前，我——

lines.en: : {i}I’ve heard. That rich family’s taking care of her now. That why you’re calling?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我听说了。那户有钱人家在照顾她了。你打电话就为这个？{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, good. You already knew. Kaori didn’t, so I wasn’t sure if-
lines.zh: : 哦，那就好。你已经知道了。Kaori 还不知道，所以我不确定——

lines.en: : {i}Fuckin’ Touka practically kidnapped me the other day to take me to her mansion. Yuki gave me the rundown there.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}前几天 Touka 那家伙简直是把绑架了我，硬拉我去她的宅邸。Yuki 在那儿把情况都跟我说了。{/i}

lines.en: : How does that make you feel?
lines.zh: : 你对此感觉如何？

lines.en: : {i}What, you my guidance counselor now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么，你现在是我的心理咨询师了？{/i}

lines.en: : I mean...kind of?
lines.zh: : 我是说……差不多吧？

lines.en: : {i}Heh...yeah, guess you are.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘿……是啊，大概是。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I feel good. Still kinda pissed that she didn’t tell me, but...I guess I might’a jumped the gun or something like that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我感觉挺好的。她没告诉我我还是有点火大，不过……我想我可能是操之过急了吧，之类的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You said Kaori doesn’t know? She actually cares?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你说 Kaori 不知道？她真的在乎？{/i}

lines.en: : She may or may not have opened a lemonade stand to try and raise money for her. And I may or may not be there right now.
lines.zh: : 她可能开、也可能没开一个柠檬水摊想为她筹钱。而我可能、也可能没正在现场。

lines.en: : {i}She did what? Seriously?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她干了什么？真的假的？{/i}

lines.en: : Well, technically, it’s a lemon {i}assistance{/i} stand. But the goal is the same.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，那是个柠檬{i}援助{/i}摊。不过目的是一样的。

lines.en: : {i}The fuck’s a lemon assistance stand?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}柠檬援助摊是个什么鬼？{/i}

lines.en: : Why not come down to the urban district and see for yourself? She’s apparently been trying to get in touch with you.
lines.zh: : 要不你来市区亲眼看看？她好像一直在试着联系你。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...I don’t know, Sensei. She ain’t...the same girl I knew growin’ up. Doesn’t even remember me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈……我不知道，Sensei。她不再是……我从小认识的那个女孩了。她甚至都不记得我了。{/i}

lines.en: : Just come down here. I know you’re not busy.
lines.zh: : 就过来吧。我知道你不忙。

lines.en: : {i}Fucker, I’ve got a job now. I ain’t just free all the time anymore.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}混蛋，我现在有工作了。我不再随时都闲着了。{/i}

lines.en: : True, but I know Noriko’s schedule and {i}she’s{/i} at work right now. So chances are, you’re free.
lines.zh: : 没错，但我知道 Noriko 的排班，{i}她{/i}现在在上班。所以十有八九，你是闲着的。

lines.en: : {i}The fuck you memorizin’ her schedule for? Stop that. It’s gross.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你他妈记她的排班干什么？别这样。恶心死了。{/i}

lines.en: : Sending you an address. See you soon, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我把地址发给你。回头见，Yumi。

lines.en: : {i}Wait! I don’t know if-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等等！我不知道能不能——{/i}

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and send Yumi my approximate location, figuring there’s a solid 90%% chance she’ll show up as she’s secretly a very family-oriented girl.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，把大致位置发给 Yumi，心想她有 90%% 的把握会来，因为她骨子里其实是个很看重家人的人。

lines.en: And a girl who, weirdly enough, I think will make a great mother one day if there’s ever anyone unfortunate enough to impregnate her and incur the wrath of the Yakuza.
lines.zh: 而且说来也怪，我觉得她将来会成为一个很好的母亲 —— 只要真有哪个倒霉蛋让她怀孕、然后招来 Yakuza 的怒火。

lines.en: It’ll probably be me, won’t it?
lines.zh: 那个倒霉蛋大概会是我吧？

lines.en: scene kaorilemons18

Whatever. I don’t want to think about that right now. I just want these two to become friends again so the entire Yamaguchi tribe can tackle Yuki’s cancer together and go see the sea turtles hatch one day.
lines.zh: 算了。我现在不想想这个。我只想让这两个人重新成为朋友，好让整个 Yamaguchi 家族一起对抗 Yuki 的癌症，然后有一天一起去看海龟孵化。

lines.en: But the thought of that is too wholesome, so I forcibly wash it down with the idea of them returning to their hotel afterward and having the weirdest, hottest foursome ever with me.
lines.zh: 但这个念头太纯洁了，所以我硬是拿另一个画面把它冲下去 —— 她们之后回到酒店，和我来一场史上最诡异、最火辣的四人行。

lines.en: I’m so good at ruining emotional moments when I’m not meticulously crafting them, aren’t I?
lines.zh: 我不刻意营造的时候，反倒特别擅长毁掉煽情时刻，对吧？

lines.en: : You are a very pretty girl.
lines.zh: : 你是个很漂亮的女孩。

lines.en: : Um...thank you?
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢？

lines.en: : I did not expect you to be taller than me. I am the older one. I am supposed to be the tall girl.
lines.zh: : 我没想到你会比我高。我才是年长的那个。我应该才是高个子的那个女孩。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s weird for me too. You were always like twice my size back when we were kids.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也觉得挺怪的。我们小时候，你一直都是我的两倍大。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons19
: So it is true that you knew me before I was me? And that this is not an elaborate prank at the hands of Yukiburger?
lines.zh: : 那么，你真的在我成为我之前就认识我了？而且这不是 Yuki 堡一手策划的精心恶作剧？

lines.en: : Yuki...burger?
lines.zh: : Yuki……堡？

lines.en: : It’s best to just not question any of the odd things she says if you can understand the general gist of her sentences.
lines.zh: : 只要能听懂她话里的大概意思，最好就别去追究她说的那些怪东西。

lines.en: : Got it...and yeah. I knew you before the...accident happened. Your parents would bring you over and just throw you in with me since there weren’t any other kids around.
lines.zh: : 明白了……是啊。在那场……事故之前我就认识你了。你爸妈会把你带过来，直接扔给我一起玩，因为附近没有别的孩子。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons20
: Can’t imagine you enjoyed it since you’re several years older, but...you were always nice to me and I, like...looked up to you and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你比我大好几岁，估计不太乐意，不过……你一直对我很好，我呢……挺崇拜你的之类的。

lines.en: : Aww...look at you two bonding.
lines.zh: : 啊……看看你们俩，感情越来越好了。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons21
: Go away, douche-fuck! This is supposed to be a private moment!
lines.zh: : 走开，混蛋玩意！这本来是私人时刻！

lines.en: : What is “douche-fuck?”
lines.zh: : 「混蛋玩意」是什么？

lines.en: scene kaorilemons22
: Just one of my many nicknames for him, but that’s beside the point. I, like...I came over here to say thanks and shit. I had no idea you were doin’ this for Yuki.
lines.zh: : 那只是我给他的众多外号之一，不过这不重要。我，就是……我是过来道谢之类的。我真不知道你在为 Yuki 做这些。

lines.en: : Aunt Yuki is the only blood-based family I had until right now. And as your honorary mothermom, I can promise I will make a lemon-assistance stand if you start dying as well.
lines.zh: : 直到现在为止，Yuki 阿姨是我唯一的血亲。而作为你的荣誉妈妈，我可以保证，如果你也开始走向死亡，我也会为你开一个柠檬援助摊。

lines.en: : I’m gonna try not to, if that’s cool. Dying ain’t really my thing.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，我会尽量不去死的。死去不是我的风格。

lines.en: : It was almost mine until I was brought back to life.
lines.zh: : 在被复活之前，我差点就属于它了。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons23
: Yeah, what the fuck happened with that? We all thought you {i}were{/i} dead. So you showin’ up again was, like...what the fuck?
lines.zh: : 是啊，那到底是怎么回事？我们都以为你{i}死了{/i}。所以你又冒出来，简直像……什么鬼？

lines.en: : I can not remember much apart from the abundance of juice and the seas of white. Those are my earliest memories.
lines.zh: : 除了大量的汁液和白色的海洋，我记不太清别的。那是我最早的记忆。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons24
: But I am sad to learn that you have so many of me that I cannot share. I apologize if this makes you hate me, but I would like to like you again.
lines.zh: : 但得知你心里有那么多「我」、却一个都不肯分给我，我很难过。如果这会让你恨我，我先道歉 —— 但我想重新喜欢上你。

lines.en: : I don’t...hate you, Kaori. It’s just...this is weird as shit. Like...goin’ from no family to...havin’ a mom again to...finding out she’s dying...and then she’s {i}not...{/i}and now I have a {i}cousin?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不……恨你，Kaori。只是……这也太他妈诡异了。就像……从没有家人，到……重新有了个妈，到……发现她快死了……然后她又{i}没{/i}死……现在我还多了个{i}表姐{/i}？

lines.en: : I just...ain’t really the type to let people in easily. And with you bein’ basically a brand new person, I’m like...I don’t know. Shit’s movin’ so fast all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不是那种容易让人走进心里的人。而你基本上是个全新的人，我就……我不知道。一切突然变得太快了。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons25
: That small creature over there with the special eyes is Nao-chan! She is my daughterbug! I found her in an alleyway with Friendburger during a treasure hunt!
lines.zh: : 那边那个眼睛很特别的小生物就是 Nao 酱！她是我的女儿虫！我在寻宝的时候和朋友堡一起在小巷里捡到她的！

lines.en: : You...found her in a...
lines.zh: : 你……在一条……里捡到她的？

lines.en: scene kaorilemons26
: I have many jobs and many interests, but furry creatures and other sorts of animals are number one!
lines.zh: : 我有很多工作和很多兴趣，但毛茸茸的生物和其他动物永远是第一！

lines.en: : I keep a friendship journal where I write down important facts about the people I like the most! My favorite color is green! And I don’t eat canteloupe because it sounds too much like “antelope!”
lines.zh: : 我有一本友谊日记，会把我最喜欢的人的重要情报记下来！我最喜欢的颜色是绿色！而且我不吃哈密瓜，因为它听起来太像「羚羊」了！

lines.en: : What is happening right now?
lines.zh: : 现在到底在发生什么？

lines.en: : I want to learn how to ride a skateboard and I accidentally became Internet famous by posting pictures of my underwear on the Instant gram! It was very embarrassing!
lines.zh: : 我想学滑板，而且我不小心因为在 Instant gram 上发了内衣照而成了网络名人！非常丢人！

lines.en: : Your turn!
lines.zh: : 该你了！

lines.en: : My turn to what? What are we doing?
lines.zh: : 轮到我干什么？我们在做什么？

lines.en: : If I tell you all of the things there are to know about me, we will no longer be strangers! We will be friends!
lines.zh: : 如果我把关于我的一切都告诉你，我们就不再是陌生人了！我们会成为朋友！

lines.en: : And I want to learn about you! All there {i}is{/i} to know! For we must start {i}somewhere{/i} in order for things to get better! Why not here?
lines.zh: : 我也想了解你！了解关于你的一切！因为我们必须从{i}某个地方{/i}开始，事情才会变好！为什么不从这里开始呢？

lines.en: scene kaorilemons27
: Then, uhh...I like junk food and...throwing shit and...I fuckin’ hate crying so I want to stop playing this game.
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……我喜欢垃圾食品，还有……扔东西，还有……我他妈讨厌哭，所以我想停掉这个游戏。

lines.en: : It’s so cute watching you grow feelings.
lines.zh: : 看着你长出感情来，真是可爱。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons28
: Yeah, wish I could say the same about you, douche-fuck!
lines.zh: : 是啊，我真希望对你也能这么说，混蛋玩意！

lines.en: : Douche-fuck!
lines.zh: : 混蛋玩意！

lines.en: scene black
: Yumi, please don’t corrupt her any more than I have. Kaori doesn’t need to learn words like-
lines.zh: : Yumi，请别把她教得比我教的更坏。Kaori 不需要学会那种词——

lines.en: A tug on my sleeve drags my attention elsewhere...
lines.zh: 袖子被拽了一下，把我的注意力拉到了别处……

lines.en: scene kaorilemons29
: Oh, Nao. Did you finish handing out your fliers?
lines.zh: : 哦，Nao。传单发完了？

lines.en: : Well, I don’t see any issue in you re-joining the conversation now that the depressing part is over and your “family” is expanding.
lines.zh: : 那个沉重的部分已经结束，你的「家人」也在增加，所以我觉得你重新加入对话没什么问题。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons30
scene kaorilemons31
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Uhh, Kaori? Some help here? I still have trouble understanding Nao without her notebook.
lines.zh: : 呃，Kaori？帮个忙？没有她的笔记本，我还是听不懂 Nao 在说什么。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons32
: Nao-chan says we should commemorate this reunion with a celebration of some type!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱说我们应该搞个什么庆祝活动，纪念这次重逢！

lines.en: : Yeah, uh...I ain’t really the {i}celebratin’{/i} type. Kinda like my privacy if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 是啊，呃……我不是那种爱{i}庆祝{/i}的人。我挺喜欢独处的，你懂我意思。

lines.en: scene kaorilemons33
: Then what if there was somewhere we could celebrate in private? With all of the trash food you could ever desire?
lines.zh: : 那如果有个地方可以私下庆祝呢？还有你想要多少就有多少的垃圾食品？

lines.en: : It will be my treat as I have earned extra money from lemon assistance that Aunt Yuki no longer requires!
lines.zh: : 我来请客，因为我从柠檬援助里多赚了些 Yuki 阿姨已经用不上的钱！

lines.en: : Yeah, uhh...I’d feel bad makin’ you pay when I just scored $10,000 the other day.
lines.zh: : 是啊，呃……我前几天刚到手一万美元，让你付钱我会过意不去的。

lines.en: : You actually got that money? I didn’t think that was ever going to happen.
lines.zh: : 你真拿到那笔钱了？我还以为这事永远不会成真呢。

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah, neither did I. Which is why I waltzed right into the trap of gettin’ lured to that damn manor to talk to my mom.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也没想到。所以我才会大大咧咧地走进那个陷阱，被拐到那座破宅邸去跟我妈说话。

lines.en: : Is your relationship with Yukiburger troubled, Yumiburger? She always speaks so lovingly of you!
lines.zh: : 你和 Yuki 堡的关系不好吗，Yumi 堡？她提起你的时候总是满怀爱意！

lines.en: : Aaaah I don’t give a shit how she speaks! Just point me in the direction of the food! I’m tired of all this emotional bullshit!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊她怎么说我根本不在乎！直接指个方向告诉我吃的在哪儿！我受够了这些煽情的废话！

lines.en: : Lead the way, Nao-chan! We will follow- wait. Friend, where are you going?
lines.zh: : 带路吧，Nao 酱！我们跟——等等。朋友，你要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Huh? Is this not a family reunion? I kind of figured the three of you would want to spend some time alone.
lines.zh: : 啊？这难道不是家庭重聚吗？我还以为你们三个会想单独待一会儿。

lines.en: : Yeah, see you later Sensei. Thanks for calling, I guess. ‘Til next time.
lines.zh: : 是啊，回头见，Sensei。谢谢你打电话来，算是吧。下次见。

lines.en: : Man, I could have sworn things were finally changing with us.
lines.zh: : 唉，我本来都敢发誓，我们之间的关系终于要变了。

lines.en: : Yeah, maybe wait until somebody {i}actually{/i} dies, doucheburger.
lines.zh: : 是啊，也许等{i}真{/i}有人死了再说吧，混蛋堡。

lines.en: : Doucheburger!
lines.zh: : 混蛋堡！

lines.en: Nao grabs hold of my sleeve once more and starts pulling me toward the other two on the way to...wherever it is we’re going.
lines.zh: Nao 又一次抓住我的袖子，开始把我往另外两个人那边拽，走向……我们要去的那个地方。

lines.en: $ kaorispring1 = True
$ kaori_love += 1
$ yumi_love += 1
$ nao_love += 1
jump naospring1
